div.p: Group workshops, TRE™ sessions and certification trainings — in Singapore, Romania and online. Led by Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer Isabelle Claus Teixeira.

div.h2: The Body in the Room · Aun Ali

p.span: Wednesday, 25 November 2026 · 7–9PM SGT · Live Online · S$88

div.p: Singapore & Bucharest · 2026–2027 · Led by Isabelle Claus Teixeira

All ticket sales are final: tickets are non-refundable and non-cancellable. Terms & Conditions

img.alt: Become a Certified TRE™ Provider — 2027 Cohort, Singapore

div.div: Module 1: 24–25 Apr · Module 2: 3–4 Jul · Module 3: 30–31 Oct 2027
div.h3: Become a Certified TRE™ Provider — 2027 Cohort
div.p: The 2027 Singapore cohort of the Global TRE™ Provider Certification — co-taught by Isabelle Claus Teixeira and Simba Stenqvist. Choose the Growth, Foundational or Refresher package — three modules in Singapore with online sessions and supervisions.

div.div: from S$2,200Early bird to 31 Mar 2027 · Growth S$5,888 · Foundational S$4,888

img.alt: TRE™ Provider Certification 2027 — Growth Package — 2027, Singapore

div.div: Module 1: 24–25 Apr · Module 2: 3–4 Jul · Module 3: 30–31 Oct 2027
div.p: For new students: the full certification with all online sessions and supervisions, ICF credits and three bonus programmes.

div.div: S$5,888Early bird to 31 Mar 2027 · regular S$6,888 · new students

img.alt: TRE™ Provider Certification 2027 — Foundational Package — 2027, Singapore

div.div: Module 1: 24–25 Apr · Module 2: 3–4 Jul · Module 3: 30–31 Oct 2027
div.p: For new students: the complete certification pathway, without ICF credits and without the bonus programmes.

div.div: S$4,888Early bird to 31 Mar 2027 · regular S$5,888 · new students

img.alt: TRE™ Provider Certification 2027 — Refresher Packages — 2027, Singapore

div.div: Module 1: 24–25 Apr · Module 2: 3–4 Jul · Module 3: 30–31 Oct 2027
div.p: For accredited TRE™ Providers and TRE™ Provider trainees: 4 options to complete your training in the 2027 Singapore cohort.

div.div: from S$2,200Early bird to 31 Mar 2027 · regular from S$2,900 · 4 options

img.alt: TRE™ Module 1 Lisboa, Portugal, 28–30 May 2027, with Isabelle Claus Teixeira and Saymara Ryon

div.p: ICF-accredited TRE™ Module 1 in Lisboa, led by Isabelle Claus Teixeira, assisted by Saymara Ryon. The 21 ICF CCEUs require the additional 4-hour Self-Care & Presence for Coaches session (30 May, 14:00–18:00). Only 25 places.

img.alt: TRE™ Certification, Portugal 2027 cohort in Lisboa, with Isabelle Claus Teixeira and Saymara Ryon

div.div: Module 1: 28–30 May · Module 2: 1–4 Jun · Module 3: 22–24 Oct 2027
div.p: The complete Global TRE™ Provider Certification in Lisboa, Portugal: three in-person modules with online personal sessions or supervisions, and 21 ICF CCEs for Module 1. Led by Isabelle Claus Teixeira. Only 25 places.

div.div: from €2,949Early bird paid in full to 31 Mar 2027 · regular €3,499 · 3 instalments available

img.alt: TRE™ Module 1 ONLINE with TRE Scotland, 18–20 June 2027

div.h3: TRE™ Module 1 ONLINE with TRE Scotland
div.p: ICF-accredited TRE™ Module 1 with 21 ICF CCEUs, taught online by Isabelle Claus Teixeira with TRE Scotland. Small group, limited to 15 participants.

div.div: from £488Early bird to 31 May 2027 · normal £589 · coaches, therapists, practitioners

img.alt: From Shaking to Shaping — Bucharest

div.p: Integrate TRE™ into your coaching practice — neurogenic tremoring as a somatic tool for nervous system regulation and embodied client presence. Two half-day in-person intensives in Bucharest, România.

img.alt: From Shaking to Shaping — Online, 3 September 2026

div.p: The 3 September 2026 online session with Isabelle Claus Teixeira & Saymara Ryon. Fully booked; this session has now taken place.

img.alt: Become a Certified TRE™ Provider

div.p: The 2026 Singapore intake of the Global TRE™ Provider Certification. This cohort is now closed — the next intake runs in 2027.

img.alt: TRE™ Module 3, Teaching TRE™ to Groups, Singapore, 20–21 February 2027

div.h3: TRE™ Module 3 — Teaching TRE™ to Groups
div.p: The final module of the 2026 Singapore cohort: a 2-day in-person workshop plus 4 online supervision sessions with Isabelle Claus Teixeira. Sold out — the 2027 cohort is open.

img.alt: TRE™ Module 2, Teaching TRE™ to One Person, Singapore, 26–27 September 2026

div.h3: TRE™ Module 2 — Teaching TRE™ to One Person
div.p: Module 2 of the 2026 Singapore cohort: a 2-day in-person workshop plus 4 online supervision sessions on guiding one person safely through TRE™, with Isabelle Claus Teixeira.

img.alt: The Body in the Room — online workshop with Aun Ali, 25 November 2026

div.p: Integrating TRE™ and somatic practice into psychotherapy — a trauma-informed approach. An online workshop with Aun Ali, Certified TRE™ Trainer and Clinically Certified Trauma Specialist, for psychologists, counsellors and narrative therapists.

img.alt: Ania Zielińska, yoga teacher

div.p: Introduction to pranayama — how conscious breathing can support your physical, mental and emotional wellbeing. An online workshop with Ania Zielińska, yoga teacher and life realignment mentor. Beginners welcome.

img.alt: Introduction to TRE™ — in person in Singapore, 2027, with Isabelle Claus Teixeira and Simba Stenqvist

div.p: A 2-hour in-person workshop for the general public in Singapore, in collaboration with TRE Thailand and Simba Stenqvist. Discover what TRE™ is and how it can benefit you. Choose one of three dates.

div.div: S$88per session · discounted S$66 with a code

img.alt: Shaking to Shaping — TRE™ for Coaches, in person in Singapore, 2027, with Isabelle Claus Teixeira and Simba Stenqvist

div.h3: Shaking to Shaping — TRE™ for Coaches
div.p: An ICF-accredited 3-hour Introduction to TRE™ for Coaches in Singapore, in collaboration with Simba Stenqvist. A full TRE™ session and how to bring it into your coaching. Choose one of three dates.

div.div: S$149per session · discounted S$129 with a code · 3 ICF CCEs

img.alt: Olga Titkova, yoga and mindfulness teacher

div.p: Experiencing deep relaxation through Yoga Nidra — an experiential online workshop with Olga Titkova, yoga and mindfulness teacher. No previous Yoga Nidra experience is required.

img.alt: Navigating Feminine & Masculine Energetics — Sara Marie, 28 October 2026

div.p: A live online workshop with Sara Marie — The Alchemist. Alchemising the pressure of masculine corporate structures into liberation, ease and personal power, through energetic transmission and somatic release.

div.div: from 88 SGD69 USD · TRE™ providers 68 SGD

img.alt: From Shaking to Shaping — live online session, 8 October 2026

div.h3: From Shaking to Shaping — Live Online Session
div.p: Use of TRE™ in a coaching context — one evening online with Isabelle Claus Teixeira, Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer, and Saymara Ryon, President of Asociația TRE™ România. Experience TRE™ live from home.

img.alt: TRE™ Module 1 — Bucharest

div.p: An immersive 3-day certification training — the first in Europe in English. Valid as Module 1 of the Global TRE™ Provider Certification Program. 21 ICF CCEUs. Co-facilitated by Isabelle Claus Teixeira and Saymara Ryon.

img.alt: Internal Alchemy — Introductory Workshop with Simba Stenqvist, 1 September 2026, Singapore

div.p: Breathwork, fascial release, grounding and tremor work in one integrated system — restoring the nervous system at the level where tension actually lives. Led by Simba Stenqvist, Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer and creator of Internal Alchemy.

img.alt: Nervous System Regulation & Neurogenic Tremoring — Singapore

div.h3: Nervous System Regulation & Self-Induced Neurogenic Tremoring
div.p: A 2-day in-person TRE™ workshop for coaches — develop embodied self-care, prevent burnout, and deepen your somatic presence with clients. Valid as Module 1 of the Global TRE™ Provider Certification Program.

div.div: from S$1,290ICF Special Price until 15 Aug
